title: InfraPatch: Cross-Task Targeted Grayscale Patch Attacks on Infrared-Adapted Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.02233v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Infrared vision-language models (IR-VLMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for multimodal perception under low-visibility conditions, yet their robustness to targeted adversarial attacks remains poorly understood. Existing adversarial patch methods mainly study RGB-based models or a single downstream task and do not characterize whether localized perturbations can induce an intended semantic target in IR-VLMs. We propose InfraPatch, a white-box, per-instance framework for targeted digital grayscale patch attacks against IR-VLMs. InfraPatch optimizes a compact single-channel patch within an approximately 5% local-area budget, combines proxy-guided placement with task-adaptive semantic objectives, and induces target behaviors in image classification, image captioning, and binary visual question answering. translated_title: InfraPatch：针对红外适配视觉-语言模型的跨任务定向灰度补丁攻击
translated_abstract: 红外视觉-语言模型（IR-VLM）已成为低能见度条件下多模态感知的一种有前景的范式，然而其对定向对抗攻击的鲁棒性仍知之甚少。现有的对抗补丁方法主要研究基于RGB的模型或单一下游任务，并未刻画局部扰动能否在IR-VLM中诱导出攻击者预期的语义目标。我们提出InfraPatch，一个针对IR-VLM的定向数字灰度补丁攻击的白盒、逐实例框架。InfraPatch在约5%的局部面积预算内优化一个紧凑的单通道补丁，将代理引导的放置策略与任务自适应的语义目标相结合，能够在图像分类、图像描述生成和二值视觉问答任务中诱导出目标行为。我们基于将DiffV2IR应用于固定3……生成的300张合成红外风格图像，对十个红外适配的模型变体进行了评估……
tldr: 提出InfraPatch，一个针对红外视觉-语言模型的跨任务白盒定向灰度补丁攻击框架，在仅约5%的局部面积预算内，通过代理引导的补丁放置与任务自适应语义目标，成功在图像分类、图像描述生成和视觉问答任务中诱导出攻击者预期的目标行为。
en_tdlr: InfraPatch is a white-box, per-instance framework for cross-task targeted grayscale patch attacks on infrared-adapted vision-language models, which optimizes a compact single-channel patch within a ~5% local-area budget and combines proxy-guided placement with task-adaptive semantic objectives to induce attacker-intended behaviors across image classification, captioning, and binary visual question answering.
